title: How a Godly Man Leads When the Group Chat Turns on Someone
caption:
The group chat doesn't look like gossip. It looks like jokes, reactions, everybody laughing along. But if the guy on the other end of it walked in right now, the tone would change, and you already know it.

Real leadership isn't the guy running the group. It's the guy willing to lose his seat in it. Christ didn't lead from a safe distance. He went first into the cost, all the way to a cross, for the people he was leading.

You don't need a speech. One flat sentence breaks the momentum: he's not here to defend himself. Say it. Then go find him after and tell him yourself.

The guy who leads isn't the loudest one in the chat. He's the one who followed up after it went quiet.

#faith #leadership #christianmen #manofgod #brotherhood
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
